integrity: Analytic proof included. Numerical checks are corroboration only. Originality assessment is provisional, and no external or independent mathematical audit was performed.
scientific_limitations: The exact model is a right equilateral triangular prism and a Haar-uniform central plane; it does not cover arbitrary affine-plane offsets, sampling noise, or non-equilateral bases. The closely relevant 2023 full manuscript was not accessible for comprehensive priority comparison.
title: Exact central-section type law and aspect-ratio recovery for equilateral triangular prisms
